header.running_head: 4. Virtues of the Dhikr of Allah...

blocks.arabic_text: يَقُولُ: لَوْ أَنَّ ابْنَ آدَمَ أُعْطِيَ وَادِياً مِلأً مِّنْ ذَهَبٍ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ ثَانِياً وَلَوْ أَُعْطِيَ ثَانِياً أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ ثَالِثاً وَلَا يَسُدُّ جَوْفَ ابْنِ آدَمَ إِلَّا التُّرَابُ وَيَتُوبُ اللهُ عَلَي مَنْ تَابَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب مايتقي من فتنة المال رقم:٦٤٣٨
blocks.tamil_translation: O people, the Prophet ﷺ used to say: “If the son of Adam were given a valley full of gold, he would long for a second. If he were given a second valley, he would long for a third. Only the soil of the grave can fill a man's belly (only after he enters the pit of the grave will he be free of greed). Yet Allah Ta'ala showers His mercy upon the servant who makes tawbah and turns his heart towards Allah Ta'ala instead of towards worldly desire. (Allah Ta'ala gives him peace of mind in this world and saves him from the greed of wanting to increase his wealth),” narrates Hazrat Abdullah ibn Zubair (RA).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ زَيْدٍ ﵁ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ يَقُولُ: مَنْ قَالَ: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ الَّذِي لَا إِلهَ إِلَّاهُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ غُفِرَ لَهُ وَإِنْ كَانَ فَرَّ مِنَ الزَّحْفِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب في الاستغفار رقم:١٥١٧، ورواه الحاكم من حديث ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ وقَالَ: صحيح علي شرط مسلم الاانه قَالَ: يَقُولُهَا ثَلَاثاً ووافقه الذهبي:٢ /١١٨
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Zaid (RA) narrates that he heard Rasulullah ﷺ say: “If someone says, “(أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ الَّذِي لَا إِلهَ إِلَّاهُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْه) I seek forgiveness for my sins from Allah Ta'ala. There is none worthy of worship besides Him; He is the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining, and to Him I make tawbah,” he is granted forgiveness, even if he had fled from the battlefield!” In another narration it is said that these words should be said three times.
